============================================================================
OmniBuf-Py Benchmark Suite (Python 3.14.5 / darwin-arm64 / Apple M1 Pro)
Workload: Canonical PeerUpdate (nested submessage, 4 neighbors, arrays, scalars)
============================================================================

### 1. Full Message Encode Speed (PeerUpdate)

| Codec / Operation | Latency (ns/op) | Throughput (ops/sec) | Wire Size (B) | vs Baseline |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| OmniBuf (Generated) | 743 ns | 1,345,797 | 366 | 1.00x (baseline) |
| OmniBuf (@dataclass) | 847 ns | 1,180,135 | 366 | 1.14x slower |
| protobuf-py | 1,219 ns | 820,035 | 341 | 1.64x slower |
| google.protobuf (upb) | 563 ns | 1,775,972 | 341 | 1.32x faster |
| msgspec | 818 ns | 1,221,850 | 634 | 1.10x slower |
| msgpack | 2,584 ns | 387,062 | 634 | 3.48x slower |
| json (stdlib) | 6,335 ns | 157,848 | 874 | 8.53x slower |
